06 / BEFORE YOU CALL

A few good questions.

All FAQs
01Do you offer 24/7 emergency plumbing services?+

Yes! We understand that plumbing emergencies can happen at any time. That's why we offer 24/7 emergency plumbing services throughout Hayward and the surrounding Bay Area. Just call us at (510) 571-6513 and we'll dispatch a technician right away.

02How much does a typical plumbing service call cost?+

Our pricing varies depending on the type of service needed. We provide free estimates and upfront pricing before starting any work. There are no hidden fees or surprise charges. Contact us for a quote specific to your situation.

03Are your plumbers licensed and insured?+

Absolutely! All our plumbers are fully licensed, bonded, and insured. We take pride in hiring only the most qualified professionals who undergo rigorous training and background checks.
